guide_language: Guide language: {name} ({origin}). Change it with --ui-language or ui_language in the configuration.
estimate_measured: from the most recent completed run
estimate_default: rough estimate with a default real-time factor of {rtf}; no completed run found
queue_total: Estimated inference time for the whole queue: {total} ({basis}). Preparation and the first model load are not included.
parameters_header: Run parameters (press Enter to accept the value in brackets)
language_unsupported: '{text}' is not a language the Qwen3-ASR model supports. Type a number from the list, a code such as it or en, or a name such as Italian; supported codes: {codes}.
language_invalid: '{text}' is not a language I recognise. Type a number from the list, a code such as it or en, or a name such as Italian.
transcript_language_note: The transcript is written in the spoken language. Translation is out of scope: run it as a separate step on the finished transcript if you need it.
context_help_prompt: Optional context replaces the built-in instruction prompt (response mode {mode}), so write it as a complete instruction.
context_backend_skipped: The {backend} backend does not use context or instructions; that question is skipped.
context_unreadable: Could not read the UTF-8 context file {path}: {error}
context_too_long: The context has {length} characters; the limit is {limit}. Shorten it (names, topic and key terms are enough).
minutes_not_number: '{text}' is not a number of minutes; type full for the whole file.
minutes_type: The scope must be a number of minutes or full.
minutes_positive: The number of minutes must be greater than zero.
ask_same_for_all: Apply these answers to all {count} files? [Y/n] (Enter = yes):
summary_model: model {model} | backend {backend} | response mode {mode} | parallel requests {parallel}
summary_versions: A different language, context or scope creates a new version in output/<source>/<version>/; earlier versions are kept.
bounded_note: Bounded runs keep the file in the input folder.
cancelled_eof: Input ended; cancelled. Nothing was processed.
no_media: No media files found in {folder}. Copy audio or video files there and start the wizard again.
language_intro: Spoken language of the recordings: type a number from the list, a code or a name. Enter keeps the value in brackets.
auto_detect_long: auto-detect (the model guesses; very short clips may be mislabelled)
language_any_code: Other languages: any ISO 639 code (for example nl, pl, ja)
menu_number_invalid: There is no option {number}: type a number from 1 to {count}, or a code or a name.
context_intro:
Context (optional) helps the model spell names and terms correctly; it is not an instruction.
   Example: Webinar on digital marketing. Speakers: Anna Rossi, Marco Bianchi. Terms: WordPress, SEO
   From a text file: @C:\path\glossary.txt (UTF-8, at most {limit} characters)
   Enter = no context
scope_intro:
How much of each file to transcribe:
   Enter or {full} = the whole file
   a number = only the first N minutes, for example 10 (handy for a quick test)
after_success_intro: After a complete transcription, what should happen to the original file?
retention_keep_all: keep everything (the original is moved to the processed folder)
retention_keep_audio: delete the original, keep only its audio as FLAC (to transcribe it again later)
retention_delete_all: delete the original and its audio (only transcripts and reports remain)
after_success_audio_estimate: The audio of this queue takes about {size} MB as FLAC.
after_success_note: Shortened, partial or failed runs never delete anything.
retention_warning: WARNING: the original file will be deleted permanently (not to the Recycle Bin) as soon as its transcript is complete.
result_original_deleted: original      : deleted (only transcripts and reports remain)
